Complete all seven window-function puzzles in the notebook (**35 points total; 5 points each**). The setup downloads a fixed version of a [coffee vending-machine sales dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ihelon/coffee-sales) and prepares daily and monthly summaries. Plotting code is provided so you can see what your queries reveal.

[Download the assignment notebook](../notebooks/assignment-04-coffee-window-functions.ipynb){download="assignment-04-coffee-window-functions.ipynb" .btn .btn-primary}

Begin during the class workday and finish independently. Run the completed queries and plots, write the brief observations and explanations requested in the notebook, and submit the notebook through Canvas. The notebook lists points for each required puzzle; see Canvas for the due date.

The first run needs internet access to download the public dataset and any missing Python packages. The notebook contains all other setup instructions.
